description.value:
Frequency once per week

Traits Paradise-Touched, divination, exploration

Choose a willing creature that has lost its memories of some period — to injury, to magic, to time. You restore that period in full. The memories are accurate: what they describe genuinely happened, in that place, at that time. Whether they belong to the creature you gave them to is resolved as a Static result, with the GM's secret flat check, and neither you nor the creature is ever told the outcome.
